literal: Seven-fold, in all seven births they will remember, their-upon distress wiped-away-those-who friendship.
translation: Through all seven states of seven births, they will remember the friendship of those who wiped away their distress.
modern: தமக்கு வந்த துன்பத்தைப் போக்கியவர்களின் நட்பை, நல்லோர் ஏழேழு பிறவிகளிலும் மறக்காமல் நினைப்பார்கள்.
explanation: This couplet emphasizes the enduring nature of gratitude for true friendship. The phrase 'எழுமை எழுபிறப்பும்' (seven-fold seven births) is a classical Tamil idiom expressing eternity or a vast span of time, indicating that true gratitude transcends a single lifetime. 'விழுமம்' refers to deep distress or suffering, and 'துடைத்தவர்' evokes the physical act of wiping away tears or removing pain. Thus, the friendship of someone who rescues another from severe hardship is so profound that it will be cherished forever.
